config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to cloud.aquasec.com (Aqua Cloud / CSPM)
2. Go to Settings → API Keys
3. Generate an API key — copy both the API Key and the API Secret (secret is shown once)
4. Paste them below. If your tenant is hosted in EU, change the endpoint to https://eu-1.api.cloudsploit.com

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Aqua Platform → Settings → API Keys → API Key

credentialFields.label: API Secret
credentialFields.helpText: Aqua Platform → Settings → API Keys → API Secret (shown once on key creation)

credentialFields.label: API Endpoint
credentialFields.helpText: Default: https://api.cloudsploit.com (US). For EU use https://eu-1.api.cloudsploit.com
